dct_description_sm: Videos (and complementary grab samples) were collected to ground-truth multibeam datasets of the fiords. The videos data were also used in the development of a substrate and habitat classification scheme for the fiords which was used for mapping purposes. Towed video transects were used to describe the benthos in a small inshore area which had previously been contaminated and was too shallow for multibeam surveys.
dct_title_s: Slaglek and Nachvak Fiords Seafloor video, Northern Labrador, 2007
